sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Nums AI has released Causilo, a pretrained tabular foundation model for classification and regression with a scikit-learn interface. It posts the top TabArena Elo among single models, ahead of Google's TabFM and LG's EXAONE Tabular. The code is Apache-2.0, while weights are licensed for non-commercial research. The post Nums AI Releases Causilo: A Tabular Foundation Model That Tops TabArena Among Single Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
